mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns despite a sustained FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of equity cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns during a FEDFUNDS > 5.25% regime, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 150,000 over 3 months indicates weakening labor demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and compresses discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns during a sustained PAYEMS > 150,000 regime, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 100,000 for 3 consecutive months signals strengthening labor demand, which raises corporate earnings expectations and compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns during a sustained PAYEMS < 100,000 regime, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production index (INDPRO) below 105 for 3 consecutive months indicates weakening domestic supply capacity, which compresses discount rates and reduces the present value of equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns despite a sustained INDPRO decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Industrial Production index (INDPRO) above 110 for 3 consecutive months signals improving supply capacity, which compresses discount rates and increases the present value of equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns despite a sustained INDPRO rise, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 280 for 3 consecutive months indicates disinflation, which reduces the real discount rate and increases the present value of equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns despite a sustained CPIAUCSL decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 290 for 3 consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, which increases the real discount rate and reduces the present value of equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns despite a sustained CPIAUCSL rise, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
